dedupe_keys.name: 3d urban traffic simulator abm in unity

description: Sedar Olmez and collaborators published this three-dimensional urban traffic simulator in Unity. Vehicle agents have configurable mass, speed limits, adherence to those limits and downforce. Outputs include agent identifiers, positions, speeds, collision counts, travelled distances and timestamps. A Jupyter Notebook example is described for analysing exported simulation output. Coverage is a configurable urban environment; the metadata does not establish a universal calibration or fixed spatial resolution. The source warns that increasing agent numbers imposes substantial computing demands. The model supports agent-based comparison of vehicle behaviour and road-traffic outcomes. Related publications and drive-cycle data are separately identified in the source, without treating them as this software release. Release 1.1.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists Unity. The release licence is MIT. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
